definitions.gloss: illustration, picture inserted in a text
definitions.explanation: An illustration or picture inserted within the pages of a book, magazine, or other printed text to complement or decorate the writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧{挿絵|さしえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦{絵本|えほん}→絵本：10429_ehon⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a picture book with beautiful illustrations.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{挿絵|さしえ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{描|えが}いた→描く：02013_egaku⟧。
examples.english: The illustrations for this novel were drawn by a famous artist.

examples.japanese: {挿絵|さしえ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧より⟦{鮮|あざ}やか→鮮やか：05702_azayaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦イメージできる→イメージする：20991_imeejisuru⟧。
examples.english: With illustrations, one can visualize the scenes of the story more vividly.

notes:
USAGE:
{挿絵|さしえ} specifically refers to illustrations within a text — not standalone artwork. It is distinct from ⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧ (picture in general) and ⟦イラスト→イラスト：10717_irasuto⟧ (illustration in the modern/commercial sense). {挿絵|さしえ} has a somewhat literary or traditional feel and is commonly used for book illustrations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挿絵|さしえ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}く→描く：02013_egaku⟧: to draw illustrations
- {挿絵|さしえ}{入|い}り: illustrated (with illustrations)
- {挿絵|さしえ}⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧: illustrator (for books)
